_notes: City economy (design doc section 7). Resolved once per city at the end of every round, using that round's season. Food and manpower are stored in the city; wood, stone and gold go to the owning faction's treasury. Until farms and mines exist (build step 4), every tile a city claims yields its raw terrain stats. Values marked suggested in the doc: starvation_shrink_rate (10%). Everything else is a placeholder to tune. growth_rate is NOT in the doc yet: population grows by this share in any round where food produced exceeds food eaten (set to 0 to disable).
